name: gizza-ai/gif-reverse
summary: Reverse an animated GIF's frame order

tool.description: Reverse the playback order of an animated GIF (last frame first). Each frame keeps its own delay so the speed is unchanged, and the result loops forever. Set boomerang=true to instead play forward then backward (ping-pong) for a seamless loop. Returns the new GIF. Provide the GIF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

boomerang.description: Play forward then backward (ping-pong) for a seamless loop instead of a plain reverse (default false). Output has 2N-1 frames.
